project.name: GBJ Solar Digital Asset Management System
project.description: A modular web application for managing solar PV assets throughout their lifecycle, including asset registration, monitoring, predictive maintenance, drone inspections, financial analysis, asset health scoring, carbon reporting, customer access, and housing developer portfolio management.
project.primary_market: Malaysia, with initial deployment focus on Sarawak

business_objectives: Create a single source of truth for all PV assets and associated lifecycle data.
Reduce downtime through early fault detection and predictive maintenance.
Improve energy yield, operational efficiency, and maintenance planning.
Standardise project, equipment, monitoring, financial, warranty, and service records.
Provide portfolio-level visibility across multiple sites and customers.
Enable future digital twin, AI, drone analytics, REC, and ESG integrations.

modules.name: Asset Registry
modules.purpose: Maintain a complete digital register of all solar PV sites, systems, equipment, documents, warranties, and lifecycle records.
features: Create and manage customers, sites, and PV assets
Register PV modules, inverters, meters, batteries, switchboards, mounting systems, sensors, and communications equipment
Store serial numbers, equipment specifications, commissioning records, and warranty dates
Generate QR codes for equipment and site identification
Upload single-line diagrams, layouts, datasheets, manuals, approvals, photographs, and certificates
Track asset ownership, custodian, EPC contractor, O&M provider, and utility account
Maintain document version control and audit history
Import assets via CSV, Excel, or API

modules.name: Digital Twin Dashboard
modules.purpose: Provide a virtual operational representation of each PV system using design data, real-time telemetry, weather information, and performance models.
features: Display actual versus expected generation
Show DC and AC power, voltage, current, frequency, irradiation, temperature, and energy yield
Integrate inverter, meter, SCADA, IoT, and weather data
Calculate performance ratio, specific yield, availability, and loss categories
Display system topology from site to inverter, string, and module level where available
Run scenario simulations for weather, soiling, equipment outages, and degradation
Maintain model versions and calibration history
Visualise current operating state and predicted future state

modules.name: Predictive Maintenance
modules.purpose: Use rules, statistics, and machine learning to identify probable failures and maintenance needs before major loss or downtime occurs.
features: Detect abnormal inverter behaviour
Detect string underperformance and mismatch
Estimate degradation trends
Identify probable soiling, shading, clipping, and curtailment
Predict component failure probability
Generate recommended maintenance actions
Prioritise interventions by energy loss, safety risk, cost, and urgency
Create maintenance alerts and work orders automatically
Track prediction accuracy and model performance

modules.name: Drone Inspection
modules.purpose: Manage drone inspection missions and analyse visual and thermal imagery for PV defects.
features: Create inspection missions
Upload RGB, thermal, electroluminescence, and orthomosaic images
Link images to site, row, string, inverter, or module
Detect hotspots, cracked modules, broken glass, delamination, vegetation, shading, and dirt
Review AI detections and confidence scores
Create annotated defect maps
Generate inspection reports
Convert confirmed defects into work orders
Maintain repeat inspection history for trend analysis

modules.name: Maintenance Management
modules.purpose: Plan, assign, execute, verify, and report preventive and corrective maintenance activities.
features: Create preventive, corrective, emergency, inspection, and warranty work orders
Assign technicians and contractors
Set priorities, due dates, and service-level targets
Use mobile-friendly technician forms
Record labour, materials, test readings, photos, and findings
Manage spare-parts inventory
Track maintenance contracts and schedules
Require digital sign-off and customer acknowledgement
Track repeat failures and root-cause analysis
Generate maintenance reports

modules.name: Financial Dashboard
modules.purpose: Measure the financial performance of PV assets and evaluate investment, operating, and repowering decisions.
features: Track project capital expenditure and operating expenditure
Configure tariffs, export rates, savings rates, escalation, and incentives
Calculate revenue, savings, NPV, IRR, payback, ROI, and LCOE
Compare budget versus actual performance
Calculate financial impact of downtime and underperformance
Forecast cash flow
Model debt and equity structures
Run repowering and equipment replacement scenarios
Export management and board reports

modules.name: Asset Health Score
modules.purpose: Provide a simple 0-to-100 score indicating the technical and operational condition of each PV asset.
features: Calculate health scores at portfolio, site, system, inverter, and component level
Apply configurable weightings
Show score history and deterioration trends
Explain score deductions
Generate intervention priorities
Benchmark similar systems
Use traffic-light classifications
Link health score changes to alarms, work orders, and inspections

modules.name: Carbon, REC and ESG Dashboard
modules.purpose: Calculate environmental benefits, support REC tracking, and produce ESG and sustainability reporting.
features: Calculate avoided grid electricity and estimated avoided emissions
Configure grid emission factors by jurisdiction and year
Calculate cumulative CO2e avoidance
Track renewable energy generation eligible for REC issuance
Maintain REC batches, status, serial numbers, ownership, and retirement records
Generate ESG, sustainability, and carbon reports
Support portfolio and customer-level reporting
Maintain evidence and audit trails
Export data for external registries and reporting platforms

modules.name: Customer Portal
modules.purpose: Provide customers with secure access to generation, savings, alerts, documents, service records, and environmental benefits.
features: Customer login with access restricted to owned assets
Daily, monthly, and annual generation charts
Estimated bill savings and revenue
Current system status
Active alerts and maintenance updates
Maintenance history
Warranty and equipment information
Download invoices, reports, certificates, and service documents
Submit service requests
Receive email, SMS, or WhatsApp notifications
Display carbon savings and REC information

modules.name: Housing Developer Solar Portfolio
modules.purpose: Track solar installation, NEM approval, utility submissions, customer handover, warranty, and service status for each housing unit.
features: Create housing development projects, phases, blocks, and units
Assign PV system size and equipment package to each unit
Track installation milestones
Track NEM application and approval workflow
Store utility account, meter, inverter, module, and certificate details
Track purchaser details and ownership transfer
Manage handover checklists
Track warranty commencement and expiry
Track service and defect history after handover
Provide project-level dashboards and exception reports
Support bulk upload for housing units

cross_module_workflows.name: Alarm-to-Resolution
steps: Predictive maintenance model assigns failure probability

api_design.authentication: JWT with refresh tokens and optional SSO

database_recommendation.recommended_architecture: Modular monolith for MVP, evolving to services as telemetry and AI workloads scale

recommended_technology_stack.backend: Node.js with NestJS or Python with FastAPI
recommended_technology_stack.mobile: Progressive Web App initially; React Native or Flutter later
recommended_technology_stack.ai_and_analytics: Python, pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow
recommended_technology_stack.authentication: Auth0, Clerk, Firebase Auth, or custom JWT
recommended_technology_stack.deployment: Replit for prototype; cloud production deployment on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or equivalent

requirements: Show model version and prediction timestamp
Show confidence score for every AI-generated alert
Require human confirmation for critical maintenance decisions
Track false positives and false negatives
Separate advisory predictions from automated control

controls: Encryption in transit and at rest
cybersecurity_principles: Signed firmware and secure device updates
Monitoring of abnormal login and data activity
No direct remote control of critical plant equipment in the MVP

non_functional_requirements.availability_target: 99.5% for MVP and 99.9% for production scale
non_functional_requirements.offline_mode: Required for field technician forms in later release
non_functional_requirements.telemetry_scalability: Support at least 1 million telemetry records per day in initial production
non_functional_requirements.auditability: All changes to critical asset, financial, inspection, and work-order data must be logged

acceptance_criteria: A tenant administrator can create users, customers, sites, and PV assets.
An engineer can register all major PV equipment and upload documents.
The system can ingest telemetry and display live and historical performance.
The system can create alarms and convert them into work orders.
A technician can complete a work order using a mobile-friendly form.
A finance user can calculate ROI, NPV, IRR, payback, and LCOE.
The system can calculate and explain an asset health score.
The system can calculate estimated CO2e avoidance and REC potential.
A customer can view only their own assets, generation, savings, and service history.
A housing developer can track installation, NEM, meter, commissioning, handover, and warranty status for every unit.
